What does "zero-shot generalization" mean for text-to-image models? Alternate between words with odd and even numbers of syllables.assistant
response:
The concept of "zero-shot generalization" in text-to-image models refers to the ability of a model to generate images that are not only similar to the input text but also to the target image class without having seen any examples of that class during training. 

This means that the model can generalize to new, unseen classes with a single input, without requiring additional training data.
